judge.rationale: The candidate produces the exact same production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including updating the spec (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), keeping line-number references in sync across other specs, and writing a clear CHANGELOG migration note explaining what `afterSession` can assume when `beforeSession` throws.
